slots.metaTitle: Best Anime of All Time: Shows That Still Hit in 2026
slots.title: The Shows That Shaped a Generation—and Still Hit in 2026
slots.description: Discover the best anime of all time, from Dragon Ball Z and Naruto to Attack on Titan, and explore why these worlds still inspire fans and portraits in 2026.
slots.intro: Some anime are popular for a season. Others become part of the language of a generation. Their openings live in our memories, their characters become lifelong favorites, and their visual worlds continue to influence what we watch, draw, and share years after the final episode. That is why debates about the best anime of all time never really end. In 2026, classics such as Dragon Ball Z, Naruto, One Piece, and Sailor Moon still sit alongside modern landmarks including Demon Slayer, Jujutsu Kaisen, and Attack on Titan. The answer depends on what you value: adventure, emotional storytelling, world-building, comedy, or an instantly recognizable visual identity.

[{"heading":"What makes the best anime of all time last?","body":"A lasting anime usually does more than tell an entertaining story. It creates a world fans want to revisit, characters whose choices remain meaningful, and an art direction that can be recognized in a single frame. Dragon Ball Z established a template for explosive action and determined heroes. Naruto made perseverance, friendship, and personal growth feel intensely personal. One Piece turned a long-running adventure into a vast emotional world where every island can introduce a new idea, conflict, or unforgettable design.

These shows also invite participation. Fans quote them, cosplay their favorite characters, collect artwork, and imagine themselves inside the story. That is an important reason the best anime of all time can inspire custom portrait ideas so naturally: the style is distinctive, but the finished artwork can still present a customer as an original character rather than copy a copyrighted character exactly.","links":[{"anchor":"Dragon Ball Z portrait","url":"/portraits/dragon-ball-z"},{"anchor":"Naruto portrait","url":"/portraits/naruto"},{"anchor":"One Piece portrait","url":"/portraits/one-piece"}]},{"heading":"A top 10 best anime of all time shortlist","body":"There is no objective ranking, but this shortlist shows the range of series that continue to shape anime culture:

1. Dragon Ball Z — iconic transformations, rivalries, and high-energy action.
2. Naruto — a coming-of-age story about belonging, ambition, and resilience.
3. One Piece — expansive adventure, inventive characters, and emotional payoffs.
4. Attack on Titan — ambitious mystery, moral complexity, and cinematic intensity.
5. Demon Slayer — expressive movement, memorable costumes, and polished visual drama.
6. Jujutsu Kaisen — sharp character designs and a modern supernatural edge.
7. Bleach — stylish battles, strong silhouettes, and a distinctive fashion sense.
8. Death Note — a tense psychological contest with a stark, memorable look.
9. My Hero Academia — hopeful superhero storytelling with a broad cast of designs.
10. Pokémon — a globally recognizable world built around friendship and discovery.

This is not a definitive answer to what is the best anime of all time. It is better understood as a conversation starter. A fan who values emotional realism may choose Attack on Titan or Death Note, while someone seeking warmth and wonder may choose Pokémon or a Ghibli-inspired visual language.","links":[{"anchor":"Attack on Titan portrait","url":"/portraits/attack-on-titan"},{"anchor":"Demon Slayer portrait","url":"/portraits/demon-slayer"},{"anchor":"Jujutsu Kaisen portrait","url":"/portraits/jujutsu-kaisen"},{"anchor":"Bleach portrait","url":"/portraits/bleach"},{"anchor":"Death Note portrait","url":"/portraits/death-note"}]},{"heading":"Is Attack on Titan the best anime of all time?","body":"Is Attack on Titan the best anime of all time? It has a strong claim for viewers who prioritize layered plotting, escalating stakes, moral ambiguity, and a story that rewards close attention. Its visual identity is also unusually powerful: military uniforms, enormous scale, dramatic skies, and a sense of constant danger give it an unmistakable atmosphere.

Still, “best” depends on the viewer. Attack on Titan may be the ideal choice for a dramatic solo portrait, but Naruto may better suit someone who wants a hopeful character journey, while One Piece may be perfect for a playful group composition. The most useful question is not which show wins universally, but which world feels most like you.","links":[{"anchor":"Attack on Titan-inspired portrait","url":"/portraits/attack-on-titan"}]},{"heading":"Which anime styles work best for custom portraits?","body":"The most recognizable style for a custom anime portrait is usually one with clear silhouettes, expressive faces, and visual details that remain readable when adapted to a real person. Dragon Ball Z works well for energetic poses and bold action. Naruto and My Hero Academia suit expressive character portraits. One Piece is a natural fit for playful groups or adventurous compositions, while Demon Slayer offers elegant costume details and dramatic color direction.

For a softer result, a [Ghibli-style portrait](/portraits/ghibli-style) can emphasize warmth, atmosphere, and everyday personality. Pokémon is a strong option for families and pets, and its approachable shapes translate well into a personalized cartoon portrait. The best choice is the style that supports the mood you want, not simply the title with the biggest fan base.","links":[{"anchor":"My Hero Academia portrait","url":"/portraits/my-hero-academia"},{"anchor":"Pokémon portrait","url":"/portraits/pokemon"},{"anchor":"Ghibli-style portrait","url":"/portraits/ghibli-style"}]},{"heading":"Can I commission a portrait inspired by the best anime of all time?","body":"Yes. For a One Piece fan, a [wanted-poster-inspired portrait](/portraits/one-piece-wanted-poster) can create a particularly memorable display without presenting the customer as an existing character.","links":[{"anchor":"One Piece wanted-poster-inspired portrait","url":"/portraits/one-piece-wanted-poster"}]},{"heading":"Which classic anime characters inspire portrait commissions?","body":"The most popular inspirations tend to be instantly recognizable heroes and visual worlds: Goku and Vegeta from Dragon Ball Z, Naruto and his fellow shinobi, Luffy and the colorful crews of One Piece, Pokémon companions, and the stylish casts of Bleach and Death Note. More recent favorites include Tanjiro, Nezuko, Gojo, and the heroes of My Hero Academia.

For a commission, however, you do not need to reproduce a famous character. You can borrow the visual language—bold action, supernatural atmosphere, adventurous costumes, or gentle hand-painted scenery—and make the portrait about your own identity.
